notes.producer: Use the applicable manufactured packaging basis. Check statutory exemptions and any eligible carry-forward; the arithmetic is not a legal obligation determination.
notes.importer: Use the applicable imported packaging basis. The March 2026 amendment specifies certificate-based fulfilment of the recycled-content obligation; recycled plastic in imported material does not count towards fulfilment. Check applicable exemptions and portal instructions.
notes.brand-owner: Use the applicable packaging-used basis. Check statutory exemptions, applicable carry-forward and reuse provisions separately.

category_notes.III: Recycled-content calculation applies only to the plastic layers' weight, not total multilayer packaging weight.
category_notes.IV: No recycled-content rate is listed in the cited table. The recycling threshold refers to industrial composting. Category V and other roles are not supported by this calculator.
